subject: phy
title: Forces, Density and Pressure
subtitle: Forces, Density and Pressure with model-based reasoning, equations, and exam application.
concept: This topic links force effects to both translational and rotational behavior, then connects mechanical work to energy transfer.
Pressure and density models explain fluid behavior and buoyancy, while moments describe turning effects around pivots.
Energy methods are powerful because they avoid unnecessary force detail and often solve problems faster.
